answer: Put m=binom(n,2), B=2^m+1, H=(n−1)^(n−1), and Q=H!. For 0≤a<2^m and 0≤i<j<n, define s(i,j)=i(2n−i−1)/2+j−i−1 and b_ij(a)=⌊a/2^{s(i,j)}⌋−2⌊a/2^{s(i,j)+1}⌋; set b_ji=b_ij and b_ii=0. Let d_i(a)=∑_{j=0}^{n−1}b_ij(a), and let L_a have diagonal entries d_i(a) and off-diagonal entries −b_ij(a). Writing L_{Ŝ} for the principal submatrix obtained by deleting the indices in S, define D_a=det((L_a)_{widehat{{1}}}), F_a=det((L_a)_{widehat{{0,1}}}), c_a=1−⌊1/(D_a+1)⌋, r_a=∏_{i=1}^{n−1}⌊1/(1+(d_i(a)−d_0(a))²)⌋, and E_a=Q n d_0(a)c_a r_a F_a/(D_a+1−c_a). Then the explicit exact formula is t_n=(1/Q)⌊log_B(∑_{a=0}^{2^m−1} B^{E_a})⌋ throughout the stated domain.
